This hub page explains how scrap moves across the region; the locality pages below cover Okhla, Mayapuri, Narela, Ghaziabad, Noida and Gurgaon in detail.

marketContext: Most batteries reach a recycler through several hands. An owner or garage sells to a neighbourhood dealer, the dealer sells to a larger aggregator, and the aggregator sells to a registered recycler. Each step takes a margin, which is why two sellers with identical batteries can be offered very different rates. Knowing your chemistry, weight and condition before you call anyone narrows that gap.

The NCR also crosses Delhi, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh, so one lot can change states on its way to a recycler. Pollution control boards, transport rules and dealer customs differ on each side. If you are unsure which part of the region you fall under, open the locality page nearest to you and use the calculator for an indicative figure.

dealerNetwork: Neighbourhood battery shops and e-rickshaw dealers are the first buyer for most small lots, while larger yards in the industrial belts consolidate material for onward sale. When you search for an old e-rickshaw battery buyer near you, treat a local dealer as a convenient starting point, not the end of the chain, and ask who the lot is finally sold to. For lithium packs in particular, that final recipient should be registered under the Battery Waste Management Rules.
logistics: Moving batteries inside Delhi takes planning. Goods vehicles face time-based entry restrictions in many parts of the city, and during the winter air-quality season (GRAP stages) extra curbs can apply to some truck movement across the NCR. Ask your buyer for a pickup window that fits these rules, and tell them early if packs are heavy, stacked or damaged so the right vehicle and handling are sent.

chemistryFocus.Lead Acid: Lead-acid still makes up much of the older e-rickshaw and e-cart fleet and the inverter batteries in shops and homes. Sets are usually four or five 12 V units, so list them per unit with the Ah rating and age.
chemistryFocus.LFP: LFP packs appear in newer three-wheeler loaders, electric scooters and backup systems. Because they hold little recoverable metal, a pack with good remaining capacity may be worth more to a refurbisher than to a recycler, so ask both kinds of buyer.
chemistryFocus.NMC: NMC packs in the NCR mostly come from electric scooters, delivery two-wheelers and some cars. List them separately from LFP, since nickel and cobalt content generally lifts their scrap value.

sellerTips: Start with the nearest locality page, because dealers in Okhla, Mayapuri, Narela, Ghaziabad and Noida each work differently and the right one saves transport cost.
Photograph labels and serial numbers of every unit before pickup so the weighment can be reconciled afterwards.
Do not mix chemistries in one lot; separate lead-acid, LFP and NMC so each is priced on its own terms.

faqs.q: Which part of Delhi NCR gets the best scrap rate for an old EV battery?
faqs.a: There is no single best location. The rate depends on chemistry, weight, condition and the transport cost to the buyer, so the closest registered buyer is often the better deal. Use the calculator for an indicative figure and compare written quotes.

faqs.q: Is it legal to sell a lithium-ion battery to any scrap dealer in Delhi?
faqs.a: Under the Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022, waste batteries should go to registered or authorised recyclers and refurbishers. A dealer can help with collection but should be able to show who the lot finally goes to.

faqs.q: Can I sell batteries from Haryana or Uttar Pradesh through this page?
faqs.a: Yes. The NCR covers parts of both states, and buyers on our network collect from cities such as Gurgaon, Noida and Ghaziabad. Mention your exact location in the form so a nearby buyer is matched.

faqs.q: What should I note down before asking for an NCR battery quote?
faqs.a: Chemistry (lead-acid, LFP or NMC), pack voltage and Ah rating, number of units, approximate weight and condition. For lithium packs, also share the cycle count or BMS readings if available.

Dealers who consolidate loads for the Delhi side can often pay a fairer rate than those who simply stockpile.
logistics: Because Moradabad is not a lithium-ion recycling hub, the price you receive reflects transport to the buyer. Larger lots are collected by vehicle on the Delhi road corridor, while a single pack may be better combined with a dealer's consolidated load. Share your exact location, pack count and condition so the matched buyer can quote pickup realistically.

chemistryFocus.Lead Acid: Lead-acid e-rickshaw and inverter batteries are the bulk of what local dealers see. Separate them from lithium, and note the Ah rating and age of each unit.
chemistryFocus.LFP: As e-loaders and newer e-rickshaws with lithium arrive in the city and nearby towns, LFP packs should be listed separately. A pack with good BMS readings may interest a refurbisher.
chemistryFocus.NMC: NMC scooter packs from dealers and service shops should be kept intact. The buyer will quote after factoring in transport, so give accurate voltage, Ah and condition details.

sellerTips: If you are a dealer, separate lead-acid, LFP and NMC packs, since mixed lots may be priced at the lowest-value chemistry.
Do not open or strip packs to sell cells separately. Intact packs are easier to inspect and safer to transport.
Consolidate small lots with other sellers where possible to reduce per-kg transport cost.
